concept.title: Topic-based modular writing

conbody.p: DITA breaks content into self-contained topics such as concept, task, and reference. This allows writers to create reusable units of information, avoid duplication across documents, and maintain consistency across large documentation sets.
Each topic should address exactly one user need. A topic about installing software should not also explain what the software does—that belongs in a separate concept topic.
